groups.name: System font stack only, no web fonts
groups.definition: Is all text set in a generic system font stack (system-ui, Helvetica Neue/Arial) with no custom web fonts loaded?

groups.name: Single sans-serif family throughout
groups.definition: Is one single sans-serif family used consistently across the whole page?

groups.name: Single serif family throughout
groups.definition: Is all text set in one serif family such as Georgia?

groups.name: Serif body with sans headings pairing
groups.definition: Does the page pair a sans-serif for headings/UI with a serif face for body paragraphs or excerpts?

groups.name: Serif headings with sans body
groups.definition: Are headings set in a serif face while body text is sans-serif?

groups.name: Condensed heavy display headline font
groups.definition: Are headlines set in a heavy condensed display face such as Impact?

groups.name: Small uppercase eyebrow above headings
groups.definition: Do small letter-spaced (uppercase or script) eyebrow labels sit above section headings?

groups.name: Small uppercase letter-spaced utility labels
groups.definition: Are minor labels (form labels, footer headings, dates, sidebar labels, CTAs) set in small uppercase with letter spacing?

groups.name: Uppercase section headings
groups.definition: Are main headings or card titles set in uppercase?

groups.name: Sentence/title case, no uppercase transform
groups.definition: Do headings, nav and labels use sentence or title case instead of all caps?

groups.name: Bold-weight headings
groups.definition: Are section headings and titles set in bold weight (about 700)?

groups.name: Very large hero headline
groups.definition: Is the hero h1 very large (e.g. about 60px or more, or filling much of the hero width)?

groups.name: Large bold heading scale vs body
groups.definition: Are headings large and bold with a dramatic size jump over body text?

groups.name: Two-tone hero headline
groups.definition: Does the hero headline use two tones, with part of it in an accent color?

groups.name: Generous body line height
groups.definition: Is body text sized about 16-17px with a roomy line height (about 1.5-1.7)?

groups.name: Large lead paragraph styling
groups.definition: Is there a distinct larger lead/body paragraph styled differently from the rest of the copy?

groups.name: Light restrained heading scale
groups.definition: Are section headings moderate in size and light in weight?

groups.name: Bold labels with regular values
groups.definition: Do contact lines bold only the labels while values stay regular weight?

groups.name: Hero h1 with accent rule and italic subtitle
groups.definition: Is the hero h1 accompanied by an accent rule and an italic serif subtitle?

groups.name: Hero subtitle as plain paragraph
groups.definition: Is the hero subtitle a plain sentence-case sans paragraph rather than a heading?
